rationale: DOX has gapped down ~31% on earnings results that were mixed (met EPS but missed revenue), creating extreme uncertainty about fair value discovery. The bid-ask spread is 115 bps, ATR is tiny relative to the gap magnitude suggesting the 5-minute ATR hasn't yet calibrated to the new volatility regime, and with only two 1-minute candles of price history in the new range there is insufficient structure to identify reliable support/resistance levels or directional conviction. The risk/reward is undefined in both directions given the chaotic early price action and wide spread.
